choices.reasoning: Solid opening hand: Black Cat is a strong turn-1 play (2-cost ally that recoups mental cards from the deck), Swinging Web Kick is premium damage for racing Rhino, and Enhanced Spider-Sense protects against treacheries on a very low 7-threat main scheme. Aunt May and Interrogation Room are the weakest cards here but serve perfectly as resource fuel for Black Cat.

Play Black Cat now as the strongest turn-1 develop: a 2-cost 2-HP ally whose ability digs 2 cards off the deck for extra mental-resource cards, and who provides a repeatable 1 THW body for the low 7-threat main scheme. I'll pay using the weaker cards (Aunt May as energy + Peter Parker's Scientist mental) and keep Swinging Web Kick, Enhanced Spider-Sense, Interrogation Room and Helicarrier in hand.

Pay with Aunt May's energy + Peter Parker's Scientist mental. This spends the two weakest cards (Aunt May is only useful if I flip back to alter-ego later, and the ability resource is free) while keeping Swinging Web Kick, Interrogation Room, Enhanced Spider-Sense and Helicarrier in hand.
Free damage: Black Cat's attack has 0 consequential damage, so she can chip Rhino for 1 every turn indefinitely. Take this before changing form.

Flip to Spider-Man: in hero form the villain attacks (draw via Spider-Sense) instead of scheming at the dangerously low 7-threat main scheme, and I can follow up with a basic attack for 3 this same turn.

Basic attack for 2 now and keep my whole hand. Plan: next turn I'll have 6 cards (this hand + draw + Spider-Sense draw), play Swinging Web Kick for 8 (paying with 3 cards), then basic attack 2 + Black Cat 1 = 11 damage total, exactly killing Rhino's 13-2=11 HP stage 1 on turn 2. Keeping Enhanced Spider-Sense, Interrogation Room and Helicarrier preserves defense vs treacheries and long-term economy, matching the same kill timing as kicking this turn.

End turn without kicking. Kicking now or next turn kills Rhino's stage 1 on the same schedule (kick 8 + basic 2 + Black Cat 1 = 11 = his remaining HP), but holding the hand keeps Enhanced Spider-Sense available to cancel a treachery during this villain phase and preserves Interrogation Room/Helicarrier as flexible resources for next turn's payment.
Only 4 cards in hand versus hand size 5 in hero form — nothing to discard, just draw up.

Do not defend. Defending with Spider-Man would exhaust him for my entire next turn, costing my basic attack 2 — exactly the damage I need alongside Swinging Web Kick (8) + Black Cat (1) = 11 to kill Rhino's stage 1 next turn. Blocking with Black Cat would kill her (Rhino hits for 2+), losing her free 1-damage-per-turn engine. Trading ~2-3 HP out of 10 for keeping the stage-1 kill on schedule is the right call.

Play Enhanced Spider-Sense to cancel Stampede's When Revealed effect. As hero I'd suffer a second Rhino attack (~2+ damage) and get stunned, which would shut off my next attack and ruin the stage-1 kill next turn. Cancelling it with the 1-cost event is clearly worth it.

Pay for Enhanced Spider-Sense with Interrogation Room's energy. Interrogation Room is the weakest card here (slow, situational threat removal) and I keep the Energy double-resource for next turn's Swinging Web Kick payment, plus Nick Fury and Helicarrier for follow-up.

Play Swinging Web Kick now. Combined with my basic attack 2 and Black Cat's 1, that's exactly Rhino's remaining 11 HP — I kill stage 1 this turn, preventing another villain attack and keeping threat control.

Pay with Energy + Nick Fury, keeping Helicarrier out of this payment... actually the trade: Nick Fury is the stronger follow-up (2 damage to all enemies, draw 2, 5-HP body) but needs a 5-card hand to afford; Helicarrier is cheaper and pays off steadily. Given the 7-threat race I want Fury's tempo — but Fury can't be played from a small hand reliably. Reconsidering: keeping Helicarrier means I deploy it next turn for 3 and save 1/phase for the rest of the game; Fury needs 5 resources from a 5-card hand (essentially my whole hand). Helicarrier is the more consistent investment here.
Black Cat attacks first (1 damage, 0 consequential) to bring Rhino to 2 HP — order matters since excess damage to a villain stage is lost, so Spider-Man's 2 should be the killing blow.
Basic attack for exactly 2 finishes Rhino stage 1.

Flip to Peter Parker before ending the turn. Math comparison: if I stay hero, Rhino (now ATK 3 + boost) hits for ~4, dropping me to 2 HP, and I'd be forced to flip next turn anyway while healing less (REC from 2 → 5). Flipping now means he schemes instead (~+3 threat, main scheme to ~4/7), but next turn I REC for 3 (6→9 HP) with a 6-card hand, then flip back to hero. That's better on both HP and the tight 7-threat clock. Flipping costs nothing this turn since Spider-Man already attacked.
Only Helicarrier in hand versus hand size 6 — no discard needed.

Play Emergency to reduce Rhino's scheme from 2 to 1. It costs 0 resources, and with the main scheme at only 7 threat total, shaving a point now gives me breathing room. The energy card lost is acceptable insurance.

Big picture: main scheme at 3/7 with 2 threat/round (1 base + 1 accel from Highway Robbery), so I must flip to hero or Rhino+Vulture scheming kills me on the spot. Plan: play Mockingbird to stun Vulture (his 3 ATK quickstrike is the scariest unavoidable damage), flip hero, then Spider-Man (2) + Mockingbird (1) thwart Highway Robbery to clear the acceleration and get Backflip back. Defend Rhino's attack with Spider-Man (DEF 3); Vulture is stunned. Pay Mockingbird with Helicarrier + Swinging Web Kick + Scientist mental — losing SWK hurts, but the stolen Backflip plus board control is worth it.

Pay with Helicarrier + The Power of Justice + Scientist mental, keeping Swinging Web Kick. With Armored Rhino Suit soaking 5 damage, Rhino's effective HP is 20 — the guaranteed 8-damage kick matters more than situational Justice-only resource fuel or the slow Helicarrier economy.
